text: Securing brand trust and reputation in an era of political polarisation and AI-driven disinformation identifies generative AI as an additional mechanism that lets malicious actors disseminate increasingly realistic disinformation at unprecedented scale to inflict financial and reputational harm. This extends Kaal's engagement-driven Web2 misinformation mechanism with a content-generation amplifier. The abstract does not isolate platform architecture as the cause or measure distrust in legal institutions.
